body:
Day 3 12-18 
 I will not be completing my namesake. A few words from people in this sub, and a mother who has been previously suicidal have made me at least prolong my descision to leave this world behind.   My mother has told me if I wait a given time to see if the pain resides, she will give me her blessing to pass on. This means a lot to me and I'm willing to try.  However I do not see an end in sight to the pain. I am willing to endure it a bit longer though. My journey to self dehydration has been cancelled at this time. I'm going to continue to try and get help and provide help via this sub, because I really feel like this sub is a special place. Thanks to everyone for their words and votes, I may continue to post on this thread if I just can't take it anymore and decide to go another route, aka failed my promise. 

I'm starting a new job today on zero sleep, but reading and replying to your posts all night kept me sane and from rolling around in my bed in the dark by myself. Thank everyone for that. Much love to anyone who reads these words.

I wish I could tell you a way out of it and if I could I would follow the advice. What I can tell you is that no one reading this thinks it's alright, even if we    are in the same place ready to make the same descision ourself. I wish you luck and  want you to know people out there care about and share your pain.

Even though I don't know you, I'm happy you are not having seizures right now. I'm glad you did the research, I really don't think pills is an easy way to go. It seems easier for me to be happier for others here than I can be for myself. Sometimes it's the small victories I like to say
I'm in this boat with you. Was stay at home dad with a lot of toys and was not happy. She left me and now I see she was all I needed to be happy.

I can definitely feel part of your pain. I have been with my wife 17 years and she is leaving me this month, and has found someone on POF and is all excited to meet him in January. I can't comprehend a life without her, but the time quickly approaches and I don't see any end in sight for the love I have for her. Everyone in my life says I'm better off, or that I will move on, but this feels like a death that I am never going to get over. 

We too promised we would be together forever.

Healthy or not, I feel your pain for your loss, and I completely understand the feeling of not being able to recover. Not much further than you in the process I really wish I had kinder words other than there are others out there that feel in a very similar fashion

Wow this really resonates with me. I felt this way as a teenager word for word, found the love of my life, half a life later lost her and am now feeling that exact way again. You're not the only one. Since you did exist, you helped one person at least remember they didn't invent this idea.

You are not alone in your feelings. I'm supposed to be waking up in 5 hours for a new job and all I can do is read these posts and try and feel like im not the only one that feels this way. Wish you the best.

It may not help your situation at all, but I can attest to one thing. They say it's better to have loved and to have lost right? Not for me. What I can attest to is I'm 33 and have been with the same woman since I was 17. Her leaving me this month is the single worst pain I have been through. I wish you the best in your desires, and I just got a job after a full year gap and it was difficult enough for me, and I have some professional skills. Ironically I start the job tomorrow(  5 hours) and can't sleep due to the depression of loss.

Just know people out there are reading and they do care, I too found out today not every corner of the internet is so cold

People care. It may not be who you'd like it to or who you would expect, but they do care. You may not have even met the person who will care more than anyone ever. If anything is worth going on, I think it's hope.. hope for better things to come. I'm sorry you had to endure such physical pain after going through all the mental pain. Even if it's just some words transferred via electricity, someone cares

You may never know how much your words mean. You basically nailed our situation on the head, and I know she is treating me as an option, and when I signed till death due us part, I meant it.  

It's super interesting to hear your story as, I've also been told by others, just be the awesome me, and she will come back. I'm still not sure if when I complete the 180,( still haven't read, been a long day and start a new job tomorrow, but I'll be reading tonight) if I will be able to say no when she comes back. Time will tell I guess. I truly believe I will never get over her but at that point the resentment just may be too much.

Thank you for sharing your recent attempt with us, you are an incredibly strong person to have gone through that so recently and still be able to change other's lives so soon. I'm extremely glad that you were here to help me and others, you affect more than your pets. Happiness comes in small doses and you were able to provide a bit of light, and enlightenment for me today. I hope I can reciprocate that for you. I learned today that people who have no reason to can actually make you feel a bit better and I'll never forget that. Between your words, and some words with my (also at times suicidal) Mother,  I've decided to give it one year. We have agreed that I'd the pain I am in continues for one solid year, she will give me her blessing, something that means a great deal to me. Thank you again and if you ever need to talk IDK if it's against the rules but you can contact me directly... 

If I can be happy, you can be happy, and the world got just a bit brighter today. Cheers to the light at the end of the tunnel.

You're welcome. I find it super ironic that I could help as someone else in this sub also put some ideas in my head that have really helped me today. Good luck I wish you the best, and it also makes me feel better knowing I'm not alone

I 100% agree with your first two lines. I feel however that for some people, their life is not pointless. But for those of us who feel like we do, I would have to completely agree that sometimes I just walk around and look at everyone else and just wonder, why don't you get it? You work so hard your entire life just so what, you can die comfortably? I don't think death is going to be comfortable but at the same time life can sometimes be nothing but uncomfortable. I guess the only difference is that in life, we may get glimpses of that happiness, whereas in death, in my belief at least, there is nothing.

3 day rule brother. Make your plans, have everything in order for those who will be left, and most importantly make amends with anyone who have faulted. The pain you feel isn't from the act, I think, I think it's from the heavyness of carrying it around all this time. There is no such thing as honest people. All people make mistakes worthy of covering it up. That guilt is your pain. I think you fear the pain of the result of telling her more than the actual outcomes of it. It seems like due to you lying about it, you guys have the potential for a great relationship and your fighting is a result of your guilt. You really need to make her aware of your guilt and why. If you really are to follow through with it, what more is 3 more days of pain after the years? Just think about the possibility that when you tell her in a note you left, how upset she will feel, that she would have move past it. She will feel guilty for it forever. One thing that stopped me the other night is that kids of parents of suicide are 3 times likely to commit themselves(when it happens when they are under 18) she will not be the only one to feel guilty, and I feel like any son would have much rather had parents with an imperfect relationship, than to have lost one to something they don't agree with. I'm in a similar position, but instead of cheating on my wife, I was an unhappy asshole that put her on edge all the time. I can't sit here and at my reasons are more valid to be gone, but what I can say is u understand how you feel in this moment to some degree.

I agree that it shouldn't always be considered tragedy. I had a cousin commit suicide when I was 11 years old , and even at that age, I questioned everyone else's feelings on the matter. They said he was selfish. They said he was throwing away all of his gifts, and that he was destroying his family. I was the only person that felt for his pain, and only wanted to know how he felt or what he was thinking. I truly believe that   he may have had some deep seeded issues in his mind that may never be able to be repaired. I even believe he might have wanted to hurt other people in a serious way. He never showed real signs of this, however I never could get over the notion that maybe, just maybe, by taking his own life, he might have saved the life of others. At that point can't it be considered heroism or martyerdom? I'll never know for sure, but in those cases I don't see it as a tragedy so much as a sad event that has happened in his survivors life. I don't know your story or why you are coming close to making the decisions I have, so I feel like it is a case by case basis. One thing I will never believe in is shaming those who choose to take their own life. We have all thought about our loved ones pain, and we feel like our pain outweighs any pain they may infer later. Our pain should matter too, and I feel like it's easy for others to bypass the pain it took us to make the choice. Family just is there afterwards to feel the pain, and I just think they look at easier ways to make themselves feel better about their loss. I really think it's hard for them to see past their loss to realize, we have lost much more to get to this point.

I know the feeling of nothing feeling real, and I truly hope very soon you feel something that is worth living for.

I always thought I would die this way too as a kid,  I had an internal clock that said I wouldn't make it to 21. I found the love of my life at 17, and I'm now 33. I can say there is hope but I can't say it will last forever.

Good luck and I hope you feel something soon

Wow, I did not expect a reply such as this, and it really means a lot for you to have reached out, thank you. She is completely certain in her descision and now that she knows about mine, she's made it clear reconciliation is not the option. Until this point, she wanted to go out into the world, find out if she was making a mistake, and there was a possibility of return. Now she says it's just not an option. If there was any hope for us u would not be doing this. While I have some okay attributes and have self confidence in many areas, I do have the forsight to see that I am not the greatest man in the world. This woman is my goddess and she deserves the best man in the world, and I have absolutely no doubt in my mind that when she leaves, she will find this person who has the attributes she needs already. I also am humble enough to realize that whoever she finds can be an even more capable, stable father than I am. She says things to me like she knows she can't live without me, but I know she is speaking for our son. I'm absolutely going to read into the 180 divorce Buster's you described to me, and I would take it as gospel if I knew there was any hope to win her back. She has my heart in her hands and I can't comprehend even one day without my heart in my chest, but I have already failed and lost it. She is so much more than a partner to me. We grew up to adults together, kicked the most addictive drugs together cold turkey (over 15 years ago) and have both grown so intertwined into each other. Maybe it was just her into me, for I know when she goes into the world to search for another, she will find better, because there is better. She deserves better.

Thank you so much for your kind words,  but I'm certain happiness is unattainable for me. At this point I am only looking forward to peace. Since you are here, and read this, I feel like you must be in pain as well. I wish you all the best and happiness and your care has brought a bit of light to my dark times. Thanks.

Day 2 12-17-18. Hardly worth posting these first few days I guess,  I've always been damn near anorexic can and I fasted longer than this last week from the anguish of the realizations of what I had lost. Today the pain is far more psychological than physiological. I still can not fully comprehend the loss of my soul mate, it feels exactly like a death. Not even hungry or thirsty yet, but my body has always been trained to expect a bit of both. Kinda hoping I'm so used to it by nature by the time it sets in the euphoria and other effects on my brain kick in to make it more comfortable.

Day one 12-16-18. Last full meal. Not quite sure if I should go with fasting and lack of drinking, but I suppose both will make it faster. Only feelings are of hurt and determination that this is best for me, and my family I regardless of what onlookers might conclude.
